symbols.docstring:
Advanced settings view for Chatterbox TTS provider

Exposes all Chatterbox "nerd knobs" for experimentation:
- Emotion control (exaggeration, CFG weight)
- Speed control
- Paralinguistic tags
- Multilingual language selection
- Streaming mode
- Seed for reproducibility
